title: Menemen
description: Eggs stirred into long green peppers and grated tomato until they set in soft, streaky curds. Eaten straight from the pan with bread.
notes: Onion or no onion is a long-running argument in Turkey. Both are correct.

steps.text: Soften the onion and long green peppers in the olive oil and butter.
Add the grated tomatoes and cook until the juice has mostly evaporated.
steps.tip: Halve the tomatoes and grate them on a box grater, cut side in; the skins stay in your hand.

steps.text: Season with the salt and pul biber, then crack in the eggs and stir only a few times, so they set in soft curds streaked with tomato.
steps.tip: Closer to a loose scramble than an omelette. Off the heat while it is still glossy.

steps.text: Finish with parsley and serve from the pan with crusty bread.
